uart.signal: real firmware (firmware-f401-demo, link-compatible reuse) boots on the stm32f767 descriptor and its USART2 output matches the uart_contains 'OK' oracle; run 2026-08-05, exit 0
uart.lane: manual example run (examples/nucleo-f767zi) - not yet CI-wired
uart.note: evidence covers the F4-profile shared IP the F767 reuses; F7-only peripherals (Ethernet/LTDC/CAN2/CAN3/USB/SAI/QSPI) are not declared in the chip yaml

spi.signal: stock stm32duino SPI.transfer on SPI1 (PA5/PA6/PA7) reads the MAX31855 device's own 32-bit frame (exact default frame 0x01901600 required for LW_L4_OK).

i2c.signal: stock stm32duino Wire on I2C1 (PB8/PB9) writes and reads back the INA219 model at 0x40: config 0x399F and bus-voltage register 0x19CA must match exactly for LW_L3_OK.
